text:
jamie: Heads-up — onboarding CI failing for sampleapp-deploy workflow. The REST orchestration expects an autoscale object but the JS SDK surface only takes a flat `scale` number. sampleapp asserts min/max and crashes during deploy.

nora: which REST shape is the sampleapp expecting?

jamie: REST payload it POSTS to /v1/deployments:create:
```
{
  "name": "worker",
  "image": "redwood/runner:stable",
  "autoscale": { "min": 1, "max": 4, "metric": "rps" },
  "concurrency_limit": 50
}
```

jamie: SDK call used in template:
```
await client.createDeployment({ name: 'worker', image: 'redwood/runner:stable', scale: 4, maxConcurrency: 50 })
// server-side validation expects autoscale.min
```

lee: ah interesting — SDK historically simplified autoscaling to a single `scale` for single-node users. we didn't map to autoscale object.

mike: extra gotcha: REST uses `concurrency_limit` snake_case; SDK uses `maxConcurrency` camelCase. downstream validation checks raw body keys and fails if concurrency_limit missing.

nora: ugh param-name drift + missing nested object. this is exactly the kind of parity regression that breaks our sample templates.

jamie: repro steps: run sampleapp deploy pipeline in CI (./scripts/onboard.sh) — it POSTs using sdk client, server responds 422 with body: `{"error":"missing_autoscale_min"}` and CI marks stage failed. ci job logs attached in the build.

ci-bot: Build #1427 failed on sampleapp/onboard (2026-03-25T14:12Z). See logs: https://ci.internal/builds/1427

lee: quick mitigation options:
  1) SDK opt-in param `autoscaleDetails=true` that returns (or accepts) a full autoscale object shape for create/update calls (non-breaking default remains existing behavior).
  2) Compatibility layer: translate `scale` -> `autoscale: {min: scale, max: scale}` and emit both keys (`scale` and `autoscale`) for 90 days.
  3) Normalize serialization to include both `concurrency_limit` and `maxConcurrency` on wire so server validators accept either.

mike: also saw another failure where REST 429 returned Retry-After=10 but SDK retried immediately with exponential backoff from 1s. led to duplicated deploy requests and transient conflicts. infra alerted.

devex-bot: Created tickets: SDK-720 (autoscaleDetails opt-in), SDK-721 (serialize compatibility keys + mapping), SDK-722 (honor Retry-After header in SDK retryer).

nora: prefer lane: land compatibility mapping ASAP so CI unblocks. then follow with an opt-in flag and deprecation plan. Need changelog blurb and a migration guide mapping SDK fields -> REST fields.

lee: I'll open a small PR to: a) translate scale -> autoscale (min/max) in the client serializer, b) emit concurrency_limit alongside maxConcurrency, c) add tests for createDeployment roundtrip. beta release today as patch.

jamie: I'll patch the sampleapp template to accept either shape (autoscale object OR scale int) so onboarding templates succeed during rollout. add an integration test for both shapes.

mike: for Retry-After change: that needs a minor version bump and a small test harness to fake server headers. targeting tomorrow morning. Will add `preferServerRetryHeader` flag default true.

nora: please include explicit examples in the migration docs: code snippets showing how to replace `scale`/`maxConcurrency` with the new `autoscale`/`concurrency_limit` and how long keys will be duplicated. Customers often copy/paste templates.

devex-bot: Linking related tickets: SDK-720, SDK-721, SDK-722, DOCS-418 (migration guide).

lee: ETA: patch PR in next 3 hours, beta in npm today. full minor with Retry-After and docs tomorrow.

jamie: thanks — once beta is published I'll rerun CI and post results. :thumbsup:

mike: adding note: we should audit other complex nested objects (routes, policies, webhooks) for similar simplifications in SDK — I'll seed a short checklist in SDK-721.

nora: great call. want that checklist in the ticket before we close parity work.

jamie: agreed — scope it to objects used by sample templates first. I'll follow up on DOCS-418 with migration snippets.
